name: Midori Caret
description: Draws the editor caret, the editor selection band, the note-title caret and the note-title selection band as real elements so the Midori theme can size them. Needed because the Midori fonts carry symmetric ascent/descent overrides, which makes everything the browser derives from font metrics centre on the baseline instead of on the ink. On iOS the native selection scrim cannot be removed, so the editor band is drawn under it on the line box rather than on the ink, matching its shape; the note-title band stays desktop-only.
author: Benjamin Loschen
